description: Auth, onboarding, profile/settings, and seed data + exercise library UI (design C.16 steps 4-6). Implements the AuthGuard 6-phase state machine with no dashboard flash, email/password + Google auth, the protected route group and fallback routes, onboarding writing the single-copy profile, editable profile/settings, the exact MON-SUN seed split + exercise library + achievement keys, and the exercise library UI. Depends on FEAT-001 (types, firebase layer, services, rules).
steps: Read .agents/tasks/forgefit/context.json and this FEAT file FIRST. Implement authStore (src/store/authStore.ts) with phase exactly per design C.2: not-configured | initializing | authed-loading-profile | unauthenticated | onboarding | ready. Config check runs first; guard starts in initializing; first onAuthStateChanged moves to unauthenticated (redirect /login) or authed-loading-profile while profileService.getProfile(uid) runs; resolves to onboarding (onboardingCompleted===false) or ready. Both loading phases render a full-screen loader with NO route change; only unauthenticated redirects. Add src/hooks/useAuth.ts.

Flesh out authService: email/password login/register/forgot-password/reset-password/logout + Google sign-in, all returning ServiceResult with friendly error mapping (C.12). Build src/components/auth/{AuthGuard,LoginForm,RegisterForm,ForgotPasswordForm}.tsx (RHF + zodResolver). AuthGuard renders the inline 'Firebase not configured' state when phase==not-configured (no navigation).

Create route group app/(protected)/layout.tsx mounting AuthGuard + nav shells, plus auth routes app/login, app/register, app/forgot-password, app/reset-password, and fallback routes app/not-configured/page.tsx and app/offline/page.tsx reusing the not-configured component. Add src/app/providers.tsx (single top-level client Providers wrapping auth/firebase-config context + optional analytics init).

Implement onboarding (app/onboarding) choosing goal/unit/experience/plan, writing the root ownership doc {uid,createdAt,updatedAt} + single-copy users/{uid}/profile/data (full UserProfile incl. onboardingCompleted:true, preferredUnit) + users/{uid}/settings/preferences (UserSettings, NO preferredUnit). ProfileSetup component. settingsStore (src/store/settingsStore.ts, persist) mints deviceId once. Editable profile + settings screens under app/(protected)/settings.

Create src/data/workoutPlan.ts encoding the EXACT C.3 MON-SUN split (MON Chest&Triceps, TUE Back&Biceps, WED Legs&Calves, THU Shoulders&Abs, FRI Arms&Core HIIT superset+HIIT, SAT Full-Body HIIT with intervalWork/RestSeconds, SUN isRest:true) with exact prescriptions and toFailure/perSide/durationSeconds flags; src/data/exercises.ts (library with primary/secondary muscles, equipment, category, difficulty, instructions, tips, alternatives); src/data/achievements.ts (the 8 achievement keys).
Build the exercise library UI under app/(protected)/exercises (RSC shell + client island): search, filter, categories, exercise details, substitutions that preserve history, custom exercises.
Run verification, fix failures, set this FEAT status to completed, record findings (e.g. auth live-behavior gaps) in findings, commit locally (no push).
acceptance_criteria: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build exit 0 with empty env; no dashboard flash and no login bounce during the profile read (FR-1, AC-16).

A React Testing Library test exercises AuthGuard phases: not-configured renders inline state, initializing/authed-loading-profile render the full-screen loader with no route change, unauthenticated redirects to /login.
Onboarding writes users/{uid}/profile/data (keyed by uid, never email) with onboardingCompleted:true; preferredUnit is written only on the profile, never on settings (AC-6).
A Vitest validates the seed plan has all 7 days, Sunday isRest:true, and every PlanEntry references a real exercise id in exercises.ts.
verification: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build  (exit 0, empty env)
pnpm vitest run src/components/auth src/data  (AuthGuard phase tests + seed-plan integrity tests pass)
Live auth, Google sign-in, and the live profile read are recorded as 'needs verification during implementation' (require real/emulated creds).
findings:
FEAT-002 complete. All four gates green with EMPTY .env.local: pnpm lint (0 warnings), pnpm typecheck (tsc --noEmit), pnpm build (next build; 14 routes, next-pwa SW generated), and 61 Vitest tests pass (12 new: 6 AuthGuard-phase + 6 seed-plan-integrity; the prior 49 still green). No initializeApp at import; getters stay null under empty env; nothing throws at import/build. No Firebase was mocked to fake success.

AUTH STATE MACHINE (src/store/authStore.ts): exact C.2 6-phase union not-configured|initializing|authed-loading-profile|unauthenticated|onboarding|ready in authStore.phase. init() is idempotent (guarded by `initialized`), runs the config check FIRST (not-configured short-circuits, no subscription), else starts 'initializing' and subscribes via authService.subscribeToAuth(onAuthStateChanged). First callback -> 'unauthenticated' (null user) OR 'authed-loading-profile' while profileService.getProfile(uid) runs; resolves to 'onboarding' (no profile OR onboardingCompleted===false) or 'ready'. A stale-uid guard drops a profile result if the auth user changed mid-read. A FAILED profile read (offline/permission) routes to 'onboarding' rather than crashing the guard (documented behavior; revisit once live creds exist). refreshProfile() re-reads + recomputes phase (used after onboarding/profile edits). reset() unsubscribes + re-derives the initial phase.

AUTHGUARD (src/components/auth/AuthGuard.tsx): renders NotConfiguredState inline on not-configured (NO navigation); renders the shared FullScreenLoader (role=status) on BOTH loading phases AND while an onboarding/unauth redirect runs (no dashboard flash, no login bounce, AC-16); redirects ONLY on 'unauthenticated' (-> /login) and 'onboarding' (-> /onboarding) via useRouter().replace in an effect; renders children only on 'ready'. useAuth (src/hooks/useAuth.ts) mounts init() once and selects phase/user/uid/profile/refreshProfile.

AUTH SERVICE (src/services/authService.ts): login/register/loginWithGoogle/sendPasswordReset/resetPassword/logout + subscribeToAuth + getCurrentUserId, all ServiceResult with mapError friendly mapping (C.12). register() sets the Firebase displayName. Added confirmReset wrapper to src/lib/firebase/auth.ts (confirmPasswordReset). getCurrentUserId retained so the FEAT-001 services.test still passes.

PROFILE SERVICE (src/services/profileService.ts, NEW; added to services barrel): getProfile (AuthGuard read; data:null when absent), completeOnboarding (writes root ownership doc users/{uid} {uid,createdAt,updatedAt} + single-copy users/{uid}/profile/data full UserProfile incl. onboardingCompleted:true + preferredUnit + users/{uid}/settings/preferences UserSettings with NO preferredUnit; keyed by uid, never email, AC-6), updateProfile/getSettings/updateSettings (merge updates), defaultSettings(deviceId) factory using DEFAULT_PROGRESSION_CONFIG. Added userRootConverter + userSettingsConverter to converters.ts (present()-spread pattern, no field:null).

ONBOARDING (src/app/onboarding + components/auth/ProfileSetup.tsx): RHF+zod goal/experience/unit/name picker; writes via completeOnboarding; redirects ready->/dashboard, unauth/not-configured->/login. settingsStore (src/store/settingsStore.ts, persist) mints deviceId once via crypto.randomUUID and also holds installPromptDismissed (for FEAT-006). Editable profile+settings under app/(protected)/settings (ProfileEditForm, SettingsForm, LogoutButton).

ROUTES/PROVIDERS: app/(protected)/layout.tsx mounts AuthGuard + Sidebar/BottomNav shells (shells inside the guard so they never flash). Auth routes login/register/forgot-password/reset-password (reset-password wraps useSearchParams in Suspense per Next 15). Fallback routes not-configured/offline reuse NotConfiguredState (not-configured) / existing copy. app/providers.tsx is the single top-level client Providers: inits auth, exposes FirebaseConfigContext (useFirebaseConfig), fires getAnalyticsClient() (guarded). A minimal /dashboard placeholder exists so 'ready' renders and redirects resolve (full dashboard is C.16 step 9).

SEED DATA: src/data/exercises.ts (36 library items with primary/secondary muscles, equipment, category, difficulty, instructions, tips, alternatives, isCustom:false) + EXERCISES_BY_ID lookup. src/data/workoutPlan.ts encodes the EXACT C.3 MON Chest&Triceps / TUE Back&Biceps / WED Legs&Calves / THU Shoulders&Abs / FRI Arms&Core HIIT (two supersets A/B) / SAT Full-Body HIIT (battle-ropes intervalWork/RestSeconds=30/30) / SUN isRest:true split with toFailure (dips), perSide (walking-lunge, woodchopper), durationSeconds (plank 60, mountain-climbers 45) flags; createDefaultPlan(uid) + SEED_PLAN_DAYS. src/data/achievements.ts: see achievement-count note below.

EXERCISE LIBRARY UI (app/(protected)/exercises + components/exercises/*): RSC shell + client island with search (name/muscle), category filter, list, ExerciseDetails (instructions/tips/muscles + substitution buttons that reference ids so history is preserved), and CustomExerciseForm. exerciseStore (src/store/exerciseStore.ts, in-memory, NOT persisted) merges seed + custom exercises.

UI PRIMITIVES: hand-written shadcn-style Button/Input/Label + FullScreenLoader + NotConfiguredState under src/components/ui (shadcn CLI not run; add-component generators were not invoked, consistent with offline/no-network build). cva used via class-variance-authority already in deps.

NEEDS VERIFICATION DURING IMPLEMENTATION (no real/emulated creds): live email/password login+register, Google popup sign-in, password reset email + confirmPasswordReset oobCode flow, the live users/{uid}/profile/data read/write, and the onboarding three-doc write against real security rules. All are coded against the guarded SDK and short-circuit to firebase/not-configured under empty env; validate once creds exist.

FOLLOW-UP NOTES FOR LATER FEATURES: (1) ACHIEVEMENT COUNT MISMATCH — the design prose says 'the 8 achievement keys' but FR-32 lists nine milestones (First Workout; 10/50/100 Workouts; 10/30-Day Streak; First PR; 10 PRs; 100,000 kg) and the AchievementKey union in src/types/goal.ts enumerates all NINE; src/data/achievements.ts encodes all nine to match the type + FR-32. If a strict 8-key count is required, reconcile the type/design, not the data. (2) CUSTOM EXERCISES are held in the in-memory exerciseStore only; there is no library collection in the C.4 Firestore schema, so persistence to Firestore is deliberately deferred (would need a schema/rules addition). (3) The dashboard placeholder, workout/progress/history/body/recovery/goals routes are stubs/absent and belong to later features; BottomNav/Sidebar already link them.
